comparison_rules: Every trial references the identical cohort manifest SHA: controller hardware/OS/power policy, target device/OS/display, app+fixture hashes, protocol/version/transport topology, tool binary/version, dependencies/language/model, compiler flags, cache/focus/window state, timeout, oracle and resource accounting.

Compare natural product modes first at the same semantic client boundary; native CLI vs persistent MCP are labelled variants with their own startup/resident costs. Provide matched-protocol subcohorts only where both products natively expose them. No artificial wrapper overhead assigned to a vendor.
Reset the test app to the exact declared state outside timing, then time capture/read/action/verification separately and the full loop. A200/acknowledgment alone is not visible success.
Cold is a vector: controller/server/session/engine/application state. Warm repeated exact bytes and warm fresh pixels are different workloads. Do not call an image-cache hit fresh OCR or FPS.

Pre-register3 randomized/Latin-square rounds of at least100 timed trials/case/variant plus10 declared warmup trials; store warmup too. Pair identical fixtures/trial IDs and alternate tool order. Host-load/thermal/power conditions and background activity recorded; no hidden cache flush or tuning.

Preserve all raw successes, errors, timeouts, cancellations, retries and unknown outcomes. Report denominator, success/failure rates, timeout bounds, attempts and duplicate mutations. Never discard failed trials to improve latency.

Report p50/p95 nearest-rank and sample counts for successful matched outcomes alongside all-attempt elapsed distribution and failures. Use paired bootstrap confidence intervals for differences/ratios; do not infer stable tails from small exploratory samples.

Record native wire UTF-8 bytes, images and normalized adapter bytes separately. Never compare characters to tokens, compressed JPEG to uncompressed PNG or full trees to selected matches without explicit modes and correctness/coverage.

Resource profile includes all owned tool/helper/daemon processes and child CPU. Record fresh peak, reply resident, idle resident and post-close cleanup separately; declare shared-page double counting, sampling granularity and GPU/device-energy omissions.
Frame freshness needs a rendered frame ID/source timestamp plus clock mapping. Unknown age remains null+reason. Fresh request time or vendor FPS is not proof of frame age.

Single mutations are never replayed after unknown delivery to make a test pass. Use an independent test-app counter and explicit refused/applied/unknown outcome. Cancel/reconnect verify no stale actions or leaked owned children.

Unsupported/not-documented/not-measured are separate statuses. A missing mapped API is not evidence a product lacks a capability. Do not force unrelated desktop managers into an agent-control leaderboard.

Agent reasoning/model token use belongs to a separate cohort with same model/version, prompt/skill context, tool discovery budget, seed/settings and allowed retries. Deterministic control-plane baselines exclude model inference.

No vendor FPS, vendor benchmark percentage, trimmed demo or forum/screenshot anecdote is a fair performance baseline. A leadership claim requires named cohort, pinned releases, declared metric weights, quality/coverage gates and reproducible paired evidence; no overall rank while incomparable or unmeasured rows remain.
